metadata.description: The public Strix plugin marketplace. strix-personal: hands-on execution control for the agents you use every day — scan, wrap, test and verify consequential actions. strix-governance: SGRF v1 governance-review lenses plus a one-shot first governed action. strix-verifier: independent, offline-capable verification of Strix records. strix-proof-room: render a self-verifying proof page. No Strix account required.

plugins.name: strix-personal
plugins.description: Execution control for the agents you use every day. Scan a repository for consequential actions (payments, deletes, sends, migrations, AI tool use), wrap the risky ones with Strix governance, test that the wrap governs, and check your status: /strix-personal:strix-scan, :strix-plan, :strix-apply, :strix-test, :strix-status, and :strix-wire. Receipts verify independently with npx @strixgov/verifier. The plugin renders proof; it never determines it.

plugins.name: strix-governance
plugins.description: Run a Strix Governance Review (SGRF v1) on a system (/strix-governance:runtime-governance-review), a PR (/strix-governance:govern-pr), or a release (/strix-governance:release-readiness) — and wire a first governed, recorded action (/strix-governance:strix-wire). Self-host governed AI egress — a de-identifying proxy for OpenAI/Anthropic calls plus a local Claude Code prompt hook (/strix-governance:govern-ai-egress). Plugin skills are namespaced /strix-governance:<skill>. The three review lenses are advisory and run anywhere; strix-wire needs no account — Sandbox Mode auto-provisions a short-lived credential and Offline Mode makes no network calls.

plugins.name: strix-verifier
plugins.description: Independently verify Strix governance artifacts — signed evidence, approvals, quorums, agent-swarm runs, tool-gateway receipts, and CT proofs. Run the namespaced skill /strix-verifier:strix-verify or the strix_verify MCP tool; Ed25519 + JWKS, offline-capable, no Strix account. The verdict is reproducible locally or fully offline.

plugins.name: strix-proof-room
plugins.description: Render a Strix Proof Room manifest into a self-verifying HTML page — live <strix-verify> embeds per record, claim binding (PROVEN/ROADMAP) enforced, no Strix account required.
